description: This Java class 'AndroidUserDictionary' manages user dictionary words for an Android keyboard application. It provides methods to read, add, and delete words from the Android system's user dictionary, scoped by locale.

classes.name: AndroidUserDictionary
classes.description: A class that interfaces with Android's user dictionary content provider to read, add, and delete words, scoped by locale.

methods.name: AndroidUserDictionary
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dictionary with context, locale, and optional change URI.

methods.name: readWordsFromActualStorage
methods.description: Reads words from the Android user dictionary storage, invoking a listener for each word.

methods.name: addWordToStorage
methods.description: Adds a new word with specified frequency to the user dictionary.

methods.name: deleteWordFromStorage
methods.description: Deletes a specified word from the user dictionary.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including the locale.

methods.name: closeStorage
methods.description: Placeholder method for closing storage resources, no operation needed.
